systems.owner: Government in discussion with private operators; World Bank Digital Sao Tome and Principe project (P177158), implemented by the Ministry of Infrastructure, Natural Resources and Environment
systems.tiers: inter-island link between São Tomé and Príncipe; procurement stalled, supply contract not signed at 8 April 2025; no local government office said to be on it

note: The project's results cover the inter-island cable, 70 educational institutions (none connected at 8 April 2025) and a government-wide data exchange layer with no system connected; it names no local government office, and 'municipality' appears only as a disaggregation of census population counts.
